name: DaxLib.SVG.Def.LinearGradient

parameters.name: defId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the gradient

parameters.name: stops
parameters.description: Concatenated list of one or more `DaxLib.SVG.Def.GradientStop` elements

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Def.LinearGradient' =
		(
			defId: STRING,
			stops: STRING,
			x1: STRING,
			y1: STRING,
			x2: STRING,
			y2: STRING
		) =>
			
			"<linearGradient" & 
			" id='" & defId & "'" &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( x1 ), " x1='" & x1 & "'" ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( y1 ), " y1='" & y1 & "'" ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( x2 ), " x2='" & x2 & "'" ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( y2 ), " y2='" & y2 & "'" ) &
			">" &
			stops &
			"</linearGradient>"
